calculation.description: Negative trailing five-session close-to-close return, using only completed bars through the decision date; higher values indicate stronger recent underperformance and expected short-term rebound. Signals are cross-asset rank usable.

validation.regime_notes: Strong positive daily admission statistics, but only 109 common valid dates in the available benchmark files; evidence is concentrated in the recent portion and should be revalidated. Five-day decay results were also positive in the accompanying horizon sweep (IC 0.03276, ICIR 0.10846).
